newsitem.title: RUSSIA: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - JUNE 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - JUNE 16.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the June 17 edition of Russia's Izvestia newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- According to the UN report on human development, Russia is moving backwards, compared to other industrial countries, on living standards.
- A Yakovlev Yak-42 airliner was illegally flown from Russia to Kazakhstan in an effort to end by force a long-time quarrel over who owns it.
- Russian and American nuclear experts held low profile talks in Boston on preparing a START-3 treaty which presupposes a dramatic new cut in nuclear arsenals.
- If the Russian government does not blunder, there is every reason to anticipate growth in the economy in the near future, says the paper's analyst.
- Fianancial and industrial groups function as a motor of economic growth, says a financial expert in a preview to an international economic forum which opens in St Petersburg on Tuesday.
